findings.id: FCF-B4: reviewed live identity becomes Ignored

findings.id: FCF-B7: local replay omits exact admission
findings.routeAndEvidence: Patch: the supported replay still derives its result from native segments and count-only strict validation. Include the newly mandatory exact checker and preserve every failure code; count maxima alone are insufficient.

findings.id: FCF-B8: original native input digest lost

findings.id: FCF-B10: hash field inventory derives from equality
